applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8, particularly Building 6 on east boundary
findings.comment: Buildings are proposed with overhead electric distribution lines present on north, east, and south boundaries of site. No surveyed conductor elevations or vertical clearance dimension annotations are provided on building elevation sheets or site plan to verify that buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead conductors.

Proposed customer facilities (buildings) exist near overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors. No dimension lines or annotations showing 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor are provided on site plan or building elevation sheets to verify compliance.

Proposed buildings with potential overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks shown with overhead electric facilities adjacent to site. No building elevation or section views provided showing surveyed conductor elevations and clearance dimensions for building projections to verify 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6 and 7 on east and south property boundaries
findings.comment: Buildings are proposed adjacent to overhead electric facilities in utility easements on east and south boundaries. No dimension annotations or surveyed conductor data provided to verify permanent clearance compliance (7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial) distinct from construction working clearances.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings where overhead facilities exist
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevations are not provided. No registered surveyor data showing the location and elevation of existing overhead distribution conductors on building elevation drawings to permit clearance verification.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and structures near overhead lines
findings.comment: Site plan and section views lack dimension lines extending from outside electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings and site features (driveways, walls, sidewalks) to demonstrate clearance compliance. Overhead utility lines are depicted on site plan but no clearance verification dimensions are shown.

applicableAreas: Wood fence along east property boundary
findings.comment: Proposed fence (wood fence shown along east boundary) exists near overhead electric distribution lines. No clearance dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor are provided on site plan or fence detail sheets to verify compliance.

Proposed wood fence posts shown at southeast corner of site appear to be positioned immediately adjacent to (within 10 feet of) existing utility pole. Fence posts must maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from utility poles per code. Fence layout must be revised to maintain required clearance distance from pole.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along east and south property boundaries
findings.comment: Concrete retaining walls are proposed along east and south boundaries with overhead electric distribution lines present above. No clearance dimensions from outside electric conductor to top of retaining wall face are provided on site plan or section views to verify minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls on east and south boundaries
findings.comment: Retaining walls are proposed near overhead electric lines. Section views or detail sheets lack dimension annotations showing clearances from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of wall for verification of compliance with UCM § 1.10.3 minimum clearance requirements.

Proposed driveway passes directly beneath overhead electric distribution line on southern property boundary. No vertical clearance dimensions shown on grading plan or section views to demonstrate compliance with minimum 16-foot clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot clearance (areas with truck traffic). No mid-span clearance verification survey provided.

applicableAreas: Entire site where overhead utility lines exist
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on site plans at all. Code requires dimension lines originating from outside conductor location (not pole centerline), but no clearance dimensions of any type are provided on Sheet 9 or other drawings relative to overhead utility lines.

applicableAreas: West boundary sidewalk and pole location
findings.comment: Proposed 5-foot concrete sidewalk along western property boundary runs in proximity to existing utility pole in right-of-way. Clearance between sidewalk and pole location cannot be verified from available site plan dimensions to confirm that sidewalk is adequately cleared from pole at property end along ROW frontage.

applicableAreas: Main southern driveway beneath overhead distribution line
findings.comment: Customer facility (driveway) is proposed to be installed directly under existing Austin Energy overhead distribution line on southern property boundary. UCM § 1.10.3 contains absolute prohibition: "Customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, billboards, etc.) shall not be installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities" regardless of clearance distances. Driveway must be relocated outside this easement area to comply with code prohibition.

applicableAreas: All driveways and areas with potential vertical clearance concerns
findings.comment: Registered surveyor survey showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is not provided. The main southern driveway appears to pass directly beneath overhead distribution lines; vertical clearance from overhead facilities to proposed driveway finish grade appears marginal or insufficient but cannot be verified without surveyed conductor elevation data and mid-span clearance measurements.

applicableAreas: Trees planted along overhead distribution line on southern boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows multiple trees, including mitigation trees, planted directly adjacent to or overlapping the overhead electric line (OHE) running along the southern property boundary. No plant schedule or species identification is provided on the landscape plan. Tree species cannot be verified against ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible (UC) list (generally mature height ≤20 feet). Applicant must provide species names and verify all trees within 10 feet of distribution conductors are utility-compatible species with maximum mature height of 20 feet.

applicableAreas: Entire site with overhead electric lines and construction activities
findings.comment: Required note on plans stating owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work near high-voltage overhead lines (Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003) is not present. Sheet 3 contains extensive Electric Transmission Notes requiring 48-hour pre-construction meeting with Austin Energy, but these address transmission-level facilities (>60kV), not the distribution-level overhead lines (typically 12.47kV or 34.5kV) actually present on site per existing survey. A specific note addressing the existing distribution overhead facilities is required on the cover sheet or general notes.
